hypotheses.text: Back-filled record: S2-001 bring-up fixes before implementation was declared complete. (1) TIME-01 redesigned after test pushback: v1 checks timezone-offset containment in the source's accepted zones with Jan/Jul seasonal honesty, not window arithmetic (full DST overlap engine is a later versioned rule); (2) aggregation tests initially overlooked fixture's Full Time vs contractor profile (CONTRACT-01 fail everywhere) — tests corrected to isolate geography; (3) guardrail allowlist refined: client components may only fetch literal same-origin relative paths; (4) findUserByEmail took the global pool instead of an injected one — integration tests caught it querying the dev DB; (5) e2e failed until 0003 was applied to the dev DB (users table absent); (6) environment: Docker Desktop had stopped — restarted explicitly. Verified: 51/51 unit, 10/10 integration, 30/30 e2e, check/build.

note: Owner accepted S2-001 on 2026-09-25 after three rounds of UI feedback (real-time validation, compact buttons, unified field styles, header logout, weekday toggles, checkbox label alignment). Diff not yet committed.
